# Lucy Music Bot <img src="https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/TeamYukki/YukkiMusicBot?color=black&logo=github&logoColor=black&style=social" alt="RELEASE">

[Lucy Music Bot](https://github.com/TeamYukki/YukkiMusicBot) is a Powerful Telegram Music+Video Bot written in Python using Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls by which you can stream songs, video and even live streams in your group calls via various sources.

* Youtube, Soundcloud, Apple Music, Spotify, Resso, Live Streams and Telegram Audios & Videos support.
* Written from scratch, making it stable and less crashes with attractive thumbnails.
* Loop, Seek, Shuffle, Specific Skip, Playlists etc support
* Multi-Language support


# ⚡️ Getting Started [[Documentation](https://notreallyshikhar.gitbook.io/yukkimusicbot/)]
